notes: The verbless clause u-vo se'ar tsahov daq gives the supplied there be to the predicate noun se'ar, with bo keeping in it; the competing reading puts there be on the preposition under rule 49. The chapter's clauses that do have an existential word (13.32 hayah, 13.21/13.26/13.31 'ayin) put there be on that word, and this reading extends the same treatment to the existential pivot when no such word is present.
